description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'AclNotModifiableException' used within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.exceptions' package. It indicates failure to modify an Access Control List (ACL) of a 'Thing' due to missing permissions. The class extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'ThingException'. It provides static methods to create instances from messages or JSON objects, and includes an inner builder class for constructing instances with custom parameters.
